moments.author: Sam Altman
moments.quote: I am very uncomfortable about people trying to ascribe religious force or a surrender of human judgment to AI models—it’s a real safety issue.
moments.why: It’s sparked massive debate among tech bros and AI watchers about the limits of anthropomorphizing AI.

moments.author: Donald J. Trump
moments.why: The blunt simplicity from Trump has gone hyper-viral—right-wing and sports circles can’t stop quoting it.

moments.author: Coinbase
moments.quote: Time to find out who's all talk. Our in‑person trading competition is officially live. Streamed from Singapore.
moments.why: Men in investing circles are hyped by a live crypto showdown—big views and FOMO across finance Twitter.

moments.author: ChampionsLeague
moments.why: A moment of sheer athleticism catching fire mid‑match; guys are sharing and replaying the highlight nonstop.
